_README: Optional extra animation clips for the bot rig, as a flat map of clip name to file.
Loaded by loadBotAnimations() in src/main.js at boot, before the first Bot is built.
Idle, Walk, Run          - already shipped inside soldier.glb; listing one overrides it
Death                    - death collapse, replacing the procedural one
Files live beside this manifest. .fbx and .glb/.gltf both work.
The rig in assets/bots/soldier.glb is stock Mixamo (mixamorig:Hips .. mixamorig:Head),
and retargeting is by track name, so any clip exported against a Mixamo skeleton binds
with no bone remapping. Download from mixamo.com as FBX, WITHOUT SKIN, and tick In
Place for locomotion clips - the bots are moved by physics, so a clip carrying root
This file is intentionally present and empty rather than absent: probing for a missing
manifest logs a 404 to the console on every boot, which the boot smoke test treats as a
runtime error and which is noise for players too.
